## Evaluation

- [ ] Direct case added or updated when activation changed.
- [ ] Indirect case added or updated when activation changed.
- [ ] Incomplete case added or updated when boundaries changed.

## Safety and project quality

- [ ] Findings still require evidence and independent verification.
- [ ] Candidate model output cannot directly block the quality gate.
- [ ] Schemas and CLI exit codes remain compatible or migration is documented.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, proprietary artifacts, or generated caches
      are included.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and public documentation are updated when required.
- [ ] `README.md` and `README.zh-CN.md` remain equivalent when public behavior
      or commands change.
- [ ] Every changed README visual has matching `en/` and `zh-CN/` assets, and
      diagrams include editable source plus rendered outputs.
